faq.grayText: Insight, structure, and execution aligned from the start.

items.question: What does Circles actually build?
items.answer: Four connected practices: AI agents and automation, product and ecommerce engineering, brand strategy and identity, and performance marketing. Most engagements combine two or three of these: an AI support agent wired into a new storefront, or a rebrand that ships alongside the site that carries it.

items.question: Do we need an AI strategy, or just an AI feature?
items.answer: Usually neither, at first. We start with an audit of where manual work is actually costing you time or money, then recommend the smallest system that solves it, sometimes a single automation, sometimes a full agent. We'd rather ship something narrow that works than something broad that doesn't.

items.question: How do you scope a new engagement?
items.answer: Every project starts with a discovery call, followed by a short written scope: goals, timeline, and what "done" looks like in measurable terms. You approve that before any design or build work starts, so there are no surprises once the invoice arrives.

items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: A brand or web engagement typically runs 4–8 weeks. AI automation projects range from a two-week single workflow to a multi-month agent build. Performance marketing and ongoing product work are retainer-based, with monthly reporting built in from day one.

items.question: Do you work with teams outside Costa Rica?
items.answer: Most of our engagements are remote-first. We're based in Pérez Zeledón, and we work with teams across North America and Latin America on the same time-zone-friendly schedule. If it helps to talk it through first, a call costs nothing.
